description: Shared evidence semantics for a Cargo compile's freshness census (BROKER-CONTRACT section 16, GB-68). RustRight's broker (rustright-policy cargo_freshness, rustright-broker cargo_evidence) is tested against these; RightKit's direct census (packages/release/freshness-census.mjs) is expected to produce the same unit, kind, cause, scope and completeness for the same inputs. A census that cannot read what exists is unavailable, never empty, and never a first build.

profileDirectory.note: the profile flag, not the subcommand, picks the directory in the census; `bench` runs the release profile through Cargo's own default, which the broker's cache bucket models separately

scope.name: the selected profile's directory only, never every profile or triple
a selected triple adds its profile directory and keeps the plain one
a release build reads release only
a profile never built here is an empty profile, not an error

census.name: units written before the start are fresh
units written at or after the start are rebuilt
an empty profile counts nothing and is unavailable, not a first build
a fingerprint directory that is not a directory is a read failure, not an empty census
more entries than the cap is unavailable, never partial
